free_tier.stated: 200 MB hard per package: 'NOTE: 200MB is the maximum size of a package on the Chocolatey Community Repository. The package must download larger tools from a vendor site or mirror, or if possible, create semi-embedded packages.'

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 200 MB per .nupkg. retention: indefinite for moderated packages; unlisted packages remain downloadable

egress.terms: Free serving, but every package is human-moderated before publication (CPMR rule set, VirusTotal scanning).

tooling: `choco push` (write, needs API key), `choco install/download` (read), NuGet v2 OData at community.chocolatey.org/api/v2/. No rclone backend.
chaining: unlimited packages x unlimited versions x 200 MB, but each package is virus-scanned and moderated. The 2 GB NuGet limitation means large content must be fetched at install time from elsewhere - which is the opposite of storage.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 200 MB per .nupkg. retention: indefinite for moderated packages; unlisted packages remain downloadable. request-rate: push is rate-limited per API key; moderation queue is the real gate.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: emain downloadable. request-rate: push is rate-limited per API key; moderation queue is the real gate. registry

reliability_note: 200 MB plus mandatory malware scanning plus human moderation. Cannot hold large binaries at all - Chocolatey's own docs route >2 GB content to external hosting.
